title: Monodromy, Logarithmic Sectors, and Two-Point Functions in Critical Topologically Massive Gravity
summary: We investigate the structure of logarithmic modes in critical topologically massive gravity (CTMG) at the chiral point $μ\ell=1$ from the perspective of analytic continuation and monodromy. Starting from the degeneration of massive and left-moving graviton modes, we construct the logarithmic mode as a derivative in parameter space and show that it acquires a natural multivalued structure upon complexification of the radial coordinate.
